name: Lahaul & Spiti
description: Lahaul & Spiti offers a rugged, high-altitude journey into a land of ancient monasteries and desolate canyons.
history: Formed in 1960, this district combines two distinct trans-Himalayan regions. Lahaul historically changed hands between Ladakh and Kullu, coming under British control in 1846. Spiti, meaning 'The Middle Land', was historically part of Ladakh and has been a bastion of Tibetan Buddhism for over 1,000 years. The Tabo Monastery, founded in 996 A.D., is one of the oldest in the world. Maharaja Ranjit Singh briefly controlled Lahaul in 1840. The region remained isolated for centuries until the recent construction of the Atal Tunnel.
culture: The culture is a profound blend of Tibetan Buddhism and rugged mountain resilience. Spiti is famous for its 'Losar' festival and masked 'Cham' dances performed by monks. Lahaul's culture is a mix of Hindu-Buddhist traditions. Communities here are known for their high-altitude agrarian skills and deep-rooted faith. Ancient thangkas, manuscripts, and the 'Deva-Loka' spiritual system define the daily lives of the inhabitants.

topSpots.name: Key Monastery
topSpots.description: The largest and oldest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Spiti Valley, perched atop a hill.

topSpots.name: Chandratal Lake
topSpots.description: The 'Moon Lake', a high-altitude spectacle that changes colors from turquoise to emerald.

topSpots.name: Hikkim Village
topSpots.description: Home to the world's highest post office, offering a glimpse into high-altitude monastic life.

topSpots.name: Kunzum Pass
topSpots.description: A high mountain pass that connects Kullu and Lahaul to the Spiti Valley.

cuisine.name: Spiti Thukpa
cuisine.description: A comforting high-altitude noodle soup with mountain herbs and hand-pulled dough.
cuisine.history: Thukpa has been the primary sustenance for the trans-Himalayan communities of Spiti for generations.
cuisine.tip: Best enjoyed with a side of spicy red chili chutney in the cold Spiti winters.

wildlife.name: Snow Leopard
wildlife.description: The 'Ghost of the Mountains', which can be spotted in the Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary during the winter months.

weather.monsoon_impact: Very low rainfall (Rain shadow zone), but access routes may be affected by rain in other districts
weather.packing_essentials: Strict thermals, heavy down jackets, sunblock (strong UV), sturdy hiking boots

festivals.name: Losar (Tibetan New Year)
festivals.description: The biggest festival in Spiti, celebrated with traditional dances and feasts.

itineraries.title: The Cold Desert Expedition
itineraries.description: A life-changing journey through the high mountain passes and ancient monasteries.

days.title: Manali to Kaza
days.description: A long, dramatic drive through the world's longest high-altitude tunnel and over the rugged Kunzum Pass into Spiti Valley.

days.title: Monastic Heritage
days.description: Visit the iconic Key Monastery and the high-perched village of Kibber. Cross the highest bridge in Asia at Chicham.

days.title: World's Highest Post Office
days.description: Mail a postcard from the highest post office in the world and walk among marine fossils in the high-altitude villages.

days.title: The Moon Lake
days.description: Visit the cliff-side Dhankar Monastery before heading to the crystal clear, crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake.

days.title: Departure
days.description: Descend back into the lush greenery of Kullu valley after a journey in the desert of Spiti.
